title.en: Mandelbrot escape-time map and iteration orbit

summary: Classify sampled parameters by detected escape and show unresolved finite-budget samples honestly.
objective: Pick c and inspect the orbit of zero on a complex plane with iteration number as the third axis.
intent_signals: Pick c and inspect the orbit of zero on a complex plane with iteration number as the third axis.
Classify sampled parameters by detected escape and show unresolved finite-budget samples honestly.
example_prompts: Build an explorable mandelbrot escape-time map and iteration orbit. Pick c and inspect the orbit of zero on a complex plane with iteration number as the third axis.

entities.name: Parameter raster
entities.guidance: Sample c in[-2,1]x[-1.5,1.5] at explicit pixel centers. Use a legend for escape iteration and a separate not-escaped-by-N state; this raster is a parameter plane, not the orbit plane.

entities.name: Orbit tower
entities.guidance: For selected c, plot points(Re z_n,Im z_n,n) on a separate labeled frame. Connect adjacent iterations with thin guides and index badges; height means integer iteration, not physical time.

entities.name: Escape boundary and trace
entities.guidance: Show radius2 on the orbit-plane projection and the selected orbit values in a table. Stop plotting after first detected escape; out-of-view markers must remain linked to their actual values.

state_contract.model: z_0=0; z_(n+1)=z_n*z_n+c. Choose integerN>=1 and finite viewport/sample dimensions. For |c|>2 mark outside by the containing-disk result. Otherwise record the first n in1..N with |z_n|^2>4; if none exists use not-escaped-by-N, never proved-inside. Record floating-point precision and any indeterminate arithmetic separately.
state_contract.authority: Parameter coordinates, N, sample grid and arithmetic policy own classifications. Palette and vertical display scale do not affect iteration; selected-orbit iteration is recomputed when c changes.
actions: Select c, single-step its recurrence and compare the corresponding pixel.
Raise N while keeping sample coordinates fixed; show which previously unresolved samples now escape.
Zoom the parameter viewport with bounds and arithmetic precision visible.
Pause orbit stepping; reset viewport, c, N and iteration index.

invariants: c=0 stays0; c=-1 alternates0,-1; c=1 reaches0,1,2,5 and first exceeds radius2 at n=3.
Equality |z_n|=2 is not the escape condition; c=-2 reaches-2,2,2 without exceeding it.
At fixed c and arithmetic policy, increasing N preserves a previously recorded first escape index. No finite non-escape alone certifies membership.
motion_guidance: A step advances an integer recurrence once. A traveling marker between successive orbit points is an authored transition, not a continuous differential equation.
Do not stretch escape heights differently per selected sample without updating the iteration-axis scale.
known_limits: Finite pixels and iteration budget approximate the set; near-boundary classification and deep zoom require numerical error analysis beyond this recipe.
A connected-looking region or repeated-looking orbit is not an interior proof. This is not a Julia-set plot, Mandelbulb geometry or a complete fractal taxonomy.
Authored recipe and prospective checks only; no runtime artifact or rendered result has been observed.

claims.statement: The Mandelbrot set consists of complex parameters c whose orbit of0 under z->z^2+c remains bounded. It lies in |c|<=2; for such parameters, an iterate outside radius2 guarantees escape. A finite iteration image can leave slowly escaping points unresolved.
claims.scope: Quadratic critical orbit starting at zero; finite non-escape is not membership proof.

source_refs.locator: Definition, finite-iteration approximation caveat, Escape Criterion and containing radius-two disk

object_craft.family: Mandelbrot escape-time map and iteration orbit
object_craft.structure: Separate the c-plane board from the orbit frame with persistent labels and selection linkage. Orbit spheres and connectors are index glyphs; their mesh radius must not be mistaken for orbit uncertainty.
object_craft.material: Use independent line weights, shapes and labels for mathematical roles. Color and surface finish are presentation choices; do not infer material physics from them.

creative_affordances: Escape palettes, contour-like bands and luminous orbit points are optional; keep classification and iteration labels readable without color.

physical_contract.scope: Derived mathematical geometry and authored inspection; no contact dynamics or calibrated physical artifact.
checks: c=0 stays0; c=-1 alternates0,-1; c=1 reaches0,1,2,5 and first exceeds radius2 at n=3.
